notes: Cash-basis county; governmental funds only (no business-type funds). Receipts/disbursements from Total Governmental Funds column on p4. Taxes 20,449,913 split into property/motor vehicle/lodging/inheritance using Statement of Activities (p2); they sum exactly. Beginning cash is total fund balance (cash plus investments combined, 21,950,972) and ending_cash is total assets 18,108,660 (cash 12,395,321 + investments 5,713,339); investments not reported separately at beginning so beginning_investments left null; ending_investments 5,713,339 (p1) is informational and already included in ending_cash. Roll-forward: 21,950,972 - 646,640 prior period adjustment + 30,982,641 - 34,178,313 = 18,108,660. Transfers in/out each 4,492,115. Detail: General Fund schedule has departments by object (Personal services mapped to salaries and wages; Operating expenses to not itemized); lines with dash actual and nonzero budget recorded as 0; all-dash lines omitted. Nonmajor schedule printed total receipts 2,719,955 includes transfers in 34,028; the trimmed PDF ends before Highway Bond Fund disbursements and total disbursements, so no nonmajor expenditure total recorded (about 598,816 of nonmajor spending cannot be captured). Nonmajor items grouped under fund Nonmajor funds (combined) with the individual fund in department. Road/Bridge and ARPA intergovernmental on p4 differ by rounding of 1 from schedule lines. Fix pass (attempt 2): detail functional categories aligned to p4 (Visitors -> culture/recreation, Health Fund and Escrow -> general government, Road/Bridge and Roads Special capital outlay -> capital outlay); Jail & Justice Bond debt service split into principal 1,325,000 and interest 1,359,510 per p4; County Treasurer -610 -> intergovernmental; Preservation fund 16,381 -> charges for services per p4.
